subject: TrenchBank security intake — evidence roadmap, retention windows, and pen-test ask
messages:
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice@trenchbank.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 6 Oct 2026 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: TrenchBank security intake — evidence roadmap, retention windows, and pen-test ask

Hi Alice — thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so we have a shared plan and owners. I kept this intentionally concise so your team can distribute.

Key pain & goals
- Auditability: you need per-request audit logs and tenant-level export for regulatory reviews (monthly snapshots, with retention policy for 7 years).
- Data residency & retention: primary production in us-west, retention windows vary by data type (session & prompt metadata: 1 year; customer PII: 7 years; audit logs: 7 years).
- Pen test & attestation: TrenchBank requires either a third-party pen test report or a pen-test window where you can run your assessment against a dedicated environment.
- SOC 2: you asked for our control mapping plus sample artifacts for the last 12 months (not full report).

Agreed next steps & owners
1) Evidence index: Redwood to share a lightweight index mapping SOC 2 controls -> artifacts (owner: Vanessa). Delivery: spreadsheet attached (redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx). Due: Thu 2026-10-08.
2) Retention matrix: send an exportable retention matrix with APIs and example retention policies per data class (owner: Karthik). Draft attached (retention-matrix.pdf). Due: Fri 2026-10-09.
3) Pen-test coordination: TrenchBank to confirm preferred window and whether you want a dedicated sandbox or lighter scoping against staging. Owner: Alice (TrenchBank). Redwood will provide test endpoints, an NDA addendum, and a contact for on-call support during the test (owner: Marissa).
4) DPA redline kickoff: once you have the evidence index, we can accelerate the DPA redline and schedule legal review (owner: Alice + Redwood legal).

Immediate asks for your team (Alice / Jake)
- Confirm pen-test window preference (sandbox vs. staging) and preferred dates by EOD Thu 2026-10-08.
- Share any non-standard retention requirements for specific workloads before Fri 2026-10-09.

Notes about scope & constraints
- Our hosted service can export audit logs as NDJSON with timestamped events and request/response hashes; full request bodies for PII can be redacted per your policy. There is a short lead time (2–3 days) to enable long-term retention buckets if you want us to pre-provision.
- If you require an on-prem install for the pen test, that will need an engineering agreement and a baseline kickoff (longer timeline).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, retention-matrix.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up with the spreadsheet and a short Loom for your team to walk through the artifact map.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162

--

From: Alice Turner <alice@trenchbank.com>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Jake Morris <jmorris@trenchbank.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 09:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: TrenchBank security intake — evidence roadmap, retention windows, and pen-test ask

Vanessa — thanks for the writeup, this is exactly what we need. Quick clarifications:
- We prefer a dedicated sandbox for the pen test (isolated environment) and target week of Oct 26 — can you provision candidate dates?
- Retention: the 7-year requirement is for all PII and audit logs. For session metadata we can accept 1 year.
- SOC 2: the control mapping is perfect; for artifacts we only need samples (system config exports, change logs, and incident response playbook excerpts).

I’ll confirm the pen-test point-of-contact (Jake) and will get back with the final date by Fri 2026-10-08.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.

— Alice Turner
Head of Security Operations | TrenchBank
alice@trenchbank.com | +1 617-555-1844
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alice Turner <alice@trenchbank.com>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 7 Oct 2026 11:18:00 -0700
Subject: Re: TrenchBank security intake — evidence roadmap, retention windows, and pen-test ask

Thanks, Alice. A couple of technical notes so expectations are aligned:
- Audit log exports: we can provide NDJSON streams and S3-compatible daily snapshots. For 7-year retention we recommend lifecycle rules to transition to infrequent access and then Glacier-equivalent storage; we can share a cost estimate once we know typical daily volume.
- PII redaction: by default we do request-body redaction at ingestion; if you need full-text retention for certain fields we can scope a vaulting flow with KMS-managed keys (adds ~2–3 week implementation + KMS onboarding).
- Pen test endpoints: sandbox can be provisioned in us-west-2 with separate VPC and ephemeral credentials. We'll need an IP allowlist and an approved test plan prior to the window.

Technical asks for TrenchBank
- Approved IP ranges for tester access (send as CIDR).
- A short pen-test plan or scoping doc (one page) including high-level targets and excluded systems.

I’ll attach an internal checklist and sample S3 lifecycle snippet in the follow-up (cc: Marissa who will own the on-call for the pen test).

— Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.com | +1 650-555-2030

Subject: Re: TrenchBank security intake — evidence roadmap, retention windows, and pen-test ask

Hi Alice / Jake — quick status update and concrete next milestones so we keep momentum:

Status: 
- Evidence index: attached (redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx). This is a curated subset of artifacts; we can expand on any control on request.
- Retention matrix: initial PDF attached. Karthik will convert to an editable CSV with lifecycle snippets by Fri 2026-10-09.

Milestones & owners: 
- 2026-10-08 EOD: TrenchBank confirms pen-test window preference (sandbox) and provides candidate dates (Alice).
- 2026-10-09 EOD: Redwood sends editable retention CSV + sample S3 lifecycle (Karthik).
- 2026-10-12: Redwood provides an example NDA addendum and on-call rotation for the pen test (Marissa).
- 2026-10-26 to 2026-10-30: Tentative pen-test window (pending TrenchBank confirmation).

On-call for the test: Marissa will be the primary engineer for the sandbox window; Karthik will be on escalation. Contact numbers are in my signature.

If you can share the CIDR ranges (for IP allowlist) and a one-page test scoping doc by Oct 12, we’ll lock the sandbox and share credentials 48 hours before the window.

Links & attachments: drive folder with artifacts: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cTrenchBank-evidence; attachments: redwood-soc2-evidence-index.xlsx, retention-matrix.pdf

Thanks — I’ll follow up after Karthik posts the CSV.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz

vanessa.ortiz@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0162
